listing.name: Truly Automated Ships v2.0
listing.summary: This mod changes automated ships so that they use less automated points when outfitted with an AI core officer, at the cost of reduced operational time.
listing.aiSummary: Changes how AI officers affect automated ships by reducing their automated ship points while increasing operational costs.

description:
Download v2.0

GitHub page

Truly Automated Ships

This mod intends to change the way AI officers assigned to automated ships affect the rest of your fleet.

In the vanilla game, AI officers increase the "automated ship points" of the ship they're attached to, and to me it doesn't make too much sense. If your automated fleet relies on the computing power of the rest of the fleet to coordinate itself - and that's why having too many automated ships leads to a decrease in maximum efficiency for all of them - then grabbing a tonne of GPUs and stitching them together with a ship should actually lift some of the weight from your regular ships, not add even more!

With this mod, when you slap a supercomputer on a hull, it will actually make the ship more autonomous, and decrease its "automated ship points," leaving you with the ability to increase the size of your automated fleet even more! But beware: all of this added computing power will be a huge drain on your resources. After all, you wouldn't expect a giant AI core with the capacity to manage entire planets to be easy to sustain, would you? The good news is that small ships will be reasonably cheap, but as hull size increases, so do operational requirements.

I NEED FEEDBACK!

Please tell me what you think about the numbers! Does CR decrease too quickly? Is the cost per deployment too high/low? I haven't been able to test this version as well as I would've wanted to, so any and all feedback is more than appreciated!

WARNING!

When using this mod on a preexisting savefile, you'll need to remove all cores that you already have on your ships and then put them back in. Otherwise, the game won't update their CR according to the mod. If you already have some cores integrated into ships by the time you install this mod, that ship's CR calculation will stay bugged. There's nothing I can do at the moment.

Let's talk numbers

SpoilerI created this mod with the intent of making it more viable to have powerful automated fleets. It's possible, for example, to have up to three Radiants in your fleet without suffering any maluses to your fleet's maximum CR. The drawback is a (sometimes hefty) reduction of the time you have available to keep your ships operational. You'll really have to think about how much increasing the power of a given ship is worth to you.

This mod will apply a reduction to the "automated ship points" of any ship outfitted with an AI core. The reduction will depend on the type of core:

Alpha core: -75%Beta core: -50%Gamma core: -25%

Having an AI core as an officer will also decrease the ship's peak performance time depending on the type of core:

Alpha core base PPT reduction: -30%Beta Core base PPT reduction: -20%Gamma Core base PPT reduction: -10%

A modifier will be applied to these base values depending on hull size. Automated points base reduction will be divided by these modifiers (making AI cores less effective on larger ships), and base PPT reduction will be multiplied by the modifiers (reflecting the vast amount of resources required to manage larger ships):

Freighters: 1Destroyers: 1.25Cruisers: 1.5Capitals: 2

Deploying an automated ship outfitted with an AI core officer will also consume more Combat Readiness depending on the type of core:

Alpha core exra CR per deployment: 60%Beta core exra CR per deployment: 40%Gamma core exra CR per deployment: 20%

Finally, an automated ship outfitted with an AI core officer will run out of combat readiness more quickly than one without, depending on the type of core:

Alpha core extra CR decay per second: 45%Beta core extra CR decay per second: 30%Gamma core extra CR decay per second: 15%

[close]

Compatibility

SpoilerTAS is compatible with all mods that don't change the "Automated ship" hullmod or the "Automated ships" technology skill. Mods that add new types of AI cores won't break TAS, but the new cores will have no effect on automated ships unless all of their parameters are added manually to the settings file. I will be working towards making TAS compatible with as many other mods as possible.

Truly Automated Ships is currently compatible with

Tahlan Shipworks 1.4

[close]

Changelog

Spoilerv2.0

Removed the previous downside for AI cores on automated ships (increased supply maintenance costs). It wasn't fun, just boringAdded downside of increased CR cost for deploymentAdded downside of reduced PPTAdded downside of increased CR consumption during combat after PPT has expired

v1.2.5

Fixed bug with CR calculationImplemented compatibility with Tahlan Shipworks 1.2.1

v1.2.4

(Hopefully) fixed negative ship weight bug

v1.2.3

Implemented compatibility with "AUTOMATED_NO_PENALTY" ship tag introduced in patch 0.96a (no functional changes)

v1.2.2

Fixed NullPointer error when loading the game(Hopefully) fixed negative ship weight bug

v1.2.1

Fixed compatibility issue with Seeker (TAS now only affects ships in the player's fleet)

v1.2

Updated values and calculations to adapt to patch 0.95.1a-RC6Added a modifier to AP reduction based on hull size (sorry, running 12 Radiants per fleet would've been a bit too much)Added settings file for customisation

v1.1.2

Fixed issue that caused cores to change the automated points of multiple ships at once

v1.1.1

Fixed compatibility issue with Seeker

v1.1

Changed base maintenance increase from 300/200/100 to 150/100/50Added hull size multiplierAdded tooltip on the "Automated Ship" hullmod to explain the increase in costChanged "Automated Ships" skill description accordingly

[close]

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to DM me on here or on Discord (preferred): Toby#2057

Please let me know what you think of the numbers. I'm open to tinkering with them to find out which values feel the best to play with.

A big thank you to all of the members of the Starsector modding community over on Discord, especially Bisou Gai. Thanks for having the patience to deal with my Java incompetence.

aiDescription: Modifies the interaction between AI cores and automated ships so that adding a core reduces the ship's automated ship points, allowing for larger automated fleets. This benefit comes at the cost of increased Combat Readiness consumption during deployment and combat, as well as reduced peak performance time. The effects scale based on the type of AI core and the hull size of the ship.
